## Why

Describe the learner, educator, or maintainer problem and link the issue.

## What changed

Explain the smallest relevant change and any behaviour deliberately left out.

## Evidence

List the commands run and their results. Add screenshots only when they contain synthetic or redacted data.

## Risk review

- [ ] No credential, personal data, private URL, production identifier, or real submission is included.
- [ ] New educational material has a clean-room provenance record or compatible attribution.
- [ ] Authentication, RLS, tenant isolation, and server-only boundaries were considered where relevant.
- [ ] AI-assisted work is disclosed below and has been reviewed by the contributor.
- [ ] Documentation and known limitations are current.
- [ ] Relevant lint, typecheck, tests, build, Deno, secret, and license checks pass.

## AI assistance

State the tool and what it helped produce, or write “None”. The contributor remains responsible for authorship, licensing, security, and correctness.
